title: In-App Browser on Desktop
description: Claude Code on desktop received a built-in browser feature during Week 28 (July 6-10, 2026). Claude can now pull up documentation, designs, or any other website and interact with pages the same way it does with local dev server previews.

community_feedback.quote: Reddit is blocked on Claude Desktop and Claude Code but Claude can read reddit this way
Claude Code on desktop now has an in-app browser. Claude can pull up docs, designs, or any other site
Claude Code can now control your browser for testing, getting data

title: Version 3.11: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Released on July 10, 2026, Cursor 3.11 introduced Side Chats that run alongside main conversations, Conversation Search for agent transcripts, redesigned project and repo pickers, new cloud agent hooks, and MCP/Organizations support in Team Marketplaces.

community_feedback.quote: Introducing side chats, a new way to ask questions and explore ideas without interrupting your main conversation

title: GitHub Copilot App Available to All
description: On July 7, 2026, GitHub made the Copilot app available on every Copilot plan including Free and GitHub Education. Users can sign in with GitHub account and start agent-driven development from desktop on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

community_feedback.quote: The GitHub Copilot app is now generally available. Pick up what's next, direct agents in parallel, and land your PRs, all in one place

title: June 2026 VS Code Releases (v1.123-v1.127)
description: Released throughout June and early July 2026, covering VS Code v1.123 through v1.127. Features include agentic browser tools GA, parallel sessions, improved cost visibility, model provider discovery from Marketplace, better Autopilot behavior, 1M context windows support, and session sync.

title: Classic Environment Setup Deprecation Notice
description: Announced that classic environment setup will be deprecated on June 30, 2026, when all organizations move to declarative configuration (blueprints). Classic machine configurations will remain available as read-only references until July 31, 2026.

title: Security Findings Integration and Multiple Platform Updates
description: Week of July 3, 2026 updates include security findings now included in AI context for PR Review, GitLab mention-only comment support, Slack bidirectional thread sync, MCP read-only mode in secure profiles, and 48+ new engineering MCP connectors in marketplace.
